scheme_name: Micro Credit Finance under NSKFDC- Haryana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana.
Applicant must be between 18 and 55 years old.
Applicant must be a Safai Karamchari or a dependent of a Safai Karamchari.
Permanent Safai Karamchari is defined as a person engaged in or employed for any sanitation work, including his/her dependents.

Applicant must produce a Certificate of Safai Karamchari or dependent issued by an authorized government officer (Head of Government Departments, elected municipal members, Pradhan of Gram Panchayat, Local Revenue Officer, Municipal Officer, Cantonment Executive Officer, or Railway officer of gazetted rank).
benefits_summary: Loans up to ₹1,00,000 per beneficiary with 10% margin money and a subsidy of 50% (maximum ₹10,000) for eligible BPL beneficiaries.
documents_required: Certificate of Safai Karamchari or dependent issued by authorized government officer
